# Add a report preview retry button

## Description

Add a retry button to the report preview. Readers can recover from a temporary loading error without leaving the report. The button keeps the selected month and filters in place. Readers often compare several reports in one tab, so keeping those choices saves them from setting up the same view again each time a request fails to load the selected report.

## Verification

- V1: The preview loads when readers retry after a temporary error.
